#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Create a release archive of the current directory.
#
# This script packages the current directory into a timestamped .tar.gz archive,
# excluding node_modules and .git directories.
#

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="./releases"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "========================================="
echo "  Deployment Archive Creator"
echo "========================================="
echo ""
echo "Project:   $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Archive:   $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Output:    $OUTPUT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo ""

# Create the tar.gz archive, excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating release archive..."
tar -czf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='releases' \
    -C "$(dirname "$(pwd)")" \
    "$PROJECT_NAME"

# Verify the archive was created
if [ -f "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
    echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
    echo "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo "  Path: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    echo ""
    echo "Contents:"
    tar -tzf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
    TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | wc -l)
    if [ "$TOTAL_FILES" -gt 20 ]; then
        echo "  ... and $((TOTAL_FILES - 20)) more files"
    fi
    echo ""
    echo "========================================="
    echo "  Deployment archive ready!"
    echo "========================================="
else
    echo "✗ Error: Failed to create archive."
    exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory,
# excluding node_modules and .git directories.
#

set -euo pipefail

# Generate a timestamped archive name based on the current directory name
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    -C "$(dirname "$(pwd)")" \
    "$(basename "$(pwd)")"

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
    echo "✓ Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME} (${ARCHIVE_SIZE})"
else
    echo "✗ Failed to create release archive." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "✔ All environment variables are set."

echo "------------------------------------------"
echo ""

# ------------------------------------------
# Create release archive
# ------------------------------------------
echo "Creating release archive..."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Create a release archive of the current directory.
#
# This script packages the current directory into a tar.gz archive,
# excluding node_modules and .git directories. The archive is named
# with the base directory name and a timestamp for easy identification.
#

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
EXCLUDE_DIRS=("node_modules" ".git")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Build the exclude flags for tar
EXCLUDE_FLAGS=()
for dir in "${EXCLUDE_DIRS[@]}"; do
    EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=("--exclude=${dir}")
done

echo "========================================"
echo "  Deployment Archive Creator"
echo "========================================"
echo ""
echo "Project:   ${DIR_NAME}"
echo "Archive:   ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Excluding: ${EXCLUDE_DIRS[*]}"
echo ""

# ------------------------------------
# Pre-deployment validation
# ------------------------------------
# Read .env.test and verify that every key defined in it has a non-empty value.
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "  Pre-deployment validation"
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo ""

if [[ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
    echo "✗ Error: ${ENV_FILE} not found. Cannot validate environment variables." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Checking required environment variables from ${ENV_FILE}..."
echo ""

MISSING_VARS=()
LINE_NUM=0

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
    LINE_NUM=$((LINE_NUM + 1))

    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
    if [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*= ]]; then
        key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    else
        echo "  ⚠ Warning: Skipping malformed line ${LINE_NUM}: ${line}"
        continue
    fi

    # Extract the value (everything after the first '=')
    value="${line#*=}"

    # Trim leading/trailing whitespace and surrounding quotes
    value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    value="${value#\"}"
    value="${value%\"}"
    value="${value#\'}"
    value="${value%\'}"

    if [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
        MISSING_VARS+=("${key}")
        echo "  ✗ ${key} — value is empty"
    else
        echo "  ✓ ${key}"
    fi
done < "${ENV_FILE}"

echo ""

if [[ ${#MISSING_VARS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "✗ Validation failed! The following variables have no value:" >&2
    for var in "${MISSING_VARS[@]}"; do
        echo "    - ${var}" >&2
    done
    echo "" >&2
    echo "Please set all required variables in ${ENV_FILE} before deploying." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "✓ All environment variables are set."
echo ""
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo ""

# Create the archive
# Also exclude any previous release archives to avoid nesting
echo "Creating release archive..."
tar "${EXCLUDE_FLAGS[@]}" --exclude="*.tar.gz" -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" -C .. "${DIR_NAME}"

# Verify the archive was created successfully
if [[ -f "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" ]]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
    echo "  File: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    echo "  Size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
    echo ""
    echo "Archive contents:"
    tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
    TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | wc -l)
    if [[ ${TOTAL_FILES} -gt 20 ]]; then
        echo "  ... and $((TOTAL_FILES - 20)) more files"
    fi
    echo ""
    echo "Total files: ${TOTAL_FILES}"
else
    echo "✗ Error: Failed to create archive." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo "  Deployment archive ready!"
echo "========================================"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory,
#             excluding node_modules and .git directories.
#

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="$(pwd)"

echo "============================================"
echo "  Deployment Archive Creator"
echo "============================================"
echo ""
echo "Project:   ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Archive:   ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Timestamp: ${TIMESTAMP}"
echo ""

# ==========================================
# Pre-deployment validation
# ==========================================
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

echo "--------------------------------------------"
echo "  Pre-deployment Validation"
echo "--------------------------------------------"
echo ""

if [ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "✘ Error: ${ENV_FILE} not found."
    echo "  Cannot validate required environment variables."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Checking required environment variables from ${ENV_FILE}..."
echo ""

VALIDATION_FAILED=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Extract the key and value
    KEY=$(echo "${line}" | cut -d'=' -f1 | xargs)
    VALUE=$(echo "${line}" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

    # Check if key is empty (malformed line)
    if [ -z "${KEY}" ]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Check if the value is empty or unset
    if [ -z "${VALUE}" ]; then
        echo "  ✘ MISSING: ${KEY} has no value"
        VALIDATION_FAILED=1
    else
        echo "  ✔ OK:      ${KEY}"
    fi
done < "${ENV_FILE}"

echo ""

if [ "${VALIDATION_FAILED}" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "✘ Validation FAILED: One or more required environment variables are missing a value."
    echo "  Please update ${ENV_FILE} and try again."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✔ All required environment variables are set."
echo ""
echo "--------------------------------------------"
echo ""

# Create a temporary file for the archive to avoid "file changed as we read it"
TMPARCHIVE=$(mktemp /tmp/"${PROJECT_NAME}_XXXXXX.tar.gz")
trap 'rm -f "${TMPARCHIVE}"' EXIT

# Create the release archive
echo "Creating release archive..."
tar -czf "${TMPARCHIVE}" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    -C "$(dirname "$(pwd)")" \
    "${PROJECT_NAME}"

# Move archive to the output directory
mv "${TMPARCHIVE}" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
trap - EXIT

# Verify the archive was created
if [ -f "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo "✔ Archive created successfully!"
    echo "  Path: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    echo "  Size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
    echo ""
    echo "Contents:"
    tar -tzf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
    TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | wc -l)
    if [ "${TOTAL_FILES}" -gt 20 ]; then
        echo "  ... and $((TOTAL_FILES - 20)) more files"
    fi
    echo ""
    echo "Total files in archive: ${TOTAL_FILES}"
else
    echo "✘ Error: Failed to create archive."
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo "  Deployment archive ready!"
echo "============================================"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory,

# Configuration

ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "============================================"
echo "  Deployment Archive Creator"
echo "============================================"
